description: Prove optional recording timelines with real browser input and retained gateway artifacts. Use an isolated Agent Chrome CDP port and validation gateway. The recorder proof serves a temporary local app and composes one parameterized color journey. Retain its artifacts in a disposable-recording-viewer run before the viewer node, and supply FARMSLOT_GATEWAY, FARMSLOT_UI_URL and FARMSLOT_TEST_RUN_ID. No product release or real user run is modified. For primary physical-device coverage, scripts/e2e-android-recording.mts requires an already acquired exclusive device lease and a published capture-helper binary; run with a 190000 ms interval to validate sustained composed recording and concurrent screenshots. Release the reservation after the process finishes. This checks recording infrastructure, not application correctness.

record.intent: Record real composed browser interactions; decode frame pixels and prove unequal action intervals survive variable-frame encoding and align with trace markers.

view.intent: Use the live gateway's recording metadata and real viewer clicks. Prove a capture marker displays the blue state, adjacent frame timestamps match actual presented frames, and slow playback is selectable.
